description: This file defines the routing configuration for a Flutter app, implementing a simple router that always shows the AuthGate widget as the root page. It includes route parsing and delegate classes to manage navigation.

classes.name: _AppRoutePath
classes.description: Represents a route path with a location string.

classes.name: _AppRouteInformationParser
classes.description: Parses route information into _AppRoutePath objects and restores route information from such objects.

classes.name: _AppRouterDelegate
classes.description: Manages navigation stack, builds the Navigator widget, and handles route path changes.

methods.name: buildRouter
methods.description: Creates and returns the RouterConfig with specified delegate and parser.

methods.name: _AppRouteInformationParser.parseRouteInformation
methods.description: Parses the current route information into a route path.

methods.name: _AppRouteInformationParser.restoreRouteInformation
methods.description: Converts a route path back into RouteInformation.

methods.name: _AppRouterDelegate.build
methods.description: Builds the Navigator widget with the AuthGate page.

methods.name: _AppRouterDelegate.setNewRoutePath
methods.description: Handles incoming route path changes; currently a no-op.
